mapper.select: /*selectBuyerMpRqQuotaSourcAdminList*/ SELECT B.CATEGORY_TEXT AS CATEGORY_TEXT, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, B.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = A.ORIGIN_CODE) ORIGIN_NAME, A.CHANGE_DATE AS ADD_DATE, DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'S','합의대상','N','합의완료','Y','코드단종') ITEM_STATUS, B.PURCHASER_NAME, B.ADD_USER_NAME, B.CATEGORY_NO, A.BUYER, B.PURCHASER_ID, B.ADD_USER_ID, A.AGENT, A.ORIGIN_CODE, C.REG_ITEM_NO, C.BTOA_USER_NAME, (SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STD_CATEG_ID = B.CATEGORY_NO) AS CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B, KEPRQDT C WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER =#{st_buyer_code} AND C.ITEM_GUBUN != 'Q' AND C.RECV_FLAG = 'CM' AND A.CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY 10,2

/*selectBuyerMpRqQuotaNewPoAdminList*/ SELECT A.BUYER_NAME BUYER_NAME, DECODE(STOCK_CNT,0,A.STATUS_TEXT,'*'||A.STATUS_TEXT) STATUS_TEXT, DECODE(SUBSTR(A.BUYER_CATEGORY_NO,0,1),'P','프로젝트발주','IP발주') PO_GBN, A.LEGACY_PO_NO LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.PO_NO PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ PO_SEQ, A.QUOTATION_NO QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ QUOTATION_SEQ, A.AGENT_NAME AGENT_NAME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.PO_DATE PO_DATE, A.GR_DATE GR_DATE, A.RD_DATE RD_DATE, A.DS_DATE DS_DATE, A.INVOICE_DATE INVOICE_DATE, A.DELIVERY_DATE DELIVERY_DATE, A.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME MAKER_NAME, A.UNIT_MEASURE UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,0) ITEM_QTY, NVL(A.GR_QTY,0) GR_QTY, NVL(A.INV_QTY,0) INV_QTY, NVL(A.DELIVERY_QTY,0) DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) UNIT_PRICE, A.PO_ITEM_AMT AS PO_ITEM_AMT, A.GR_ITEM_AMT AS GR_ITEM_AMT, A.PO_USER_NAME PO_USER_NAME, A.REQ_DEPT_NAME REQ_DEPT_NAME, A.AGENT_CODE AGENT_CODE, (SELECT IRS_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT_CODE) IRS_NO, A.CONTRACT_NO CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ CONTRACT_SEQ, A.BUYER BUYER, A.REQ_DEPT_CODE REQ_DEPT_CODE, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER_CATEGORY_NO BUYER_CATEGORY_NO, A.BUYER_CATEG_NAME BUYER_CATEG_NAME, A.BUYER_CATEG_PATH BUYER_CATEG_PATH FROM ( SELECT /*+LEADING(A) INDEX(A ICOMCQDT_03) */ MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, D.PO_NO PO_NO, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX(H.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_DATE, MAX(D.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, MAX(G.GR_DATE) AS GR_DATE, MAX(D.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY, SUM(NVL(G.ITEM_QTY,0)) AS GR_QTY, MAX(D.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE, MAX(H.PURCHASER_NAME) AS PO_USER_NAME, D.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, MAX(D.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO, MAX(D.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX((SELECT MIN(INVOICE_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS INVOICE_DATE, MAX(D.DS_DATE) AS DS_DATE, MAX((SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS DELIVERY_DATE, MAX(NVL(D.IV_QTY,0)) AS INV_QTY, MAX(NVL(D.DI_QTY,0)) AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(G.AGENT_PRICE,D.AGENT_PRICE) AS AGENT_PRICE, MAX(D.ITEM_AMT) PO_ITEM_AMT, SUM(G.ITEM_AMT) GR_ITEM_AMT, MAX((SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT)) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, MAX(D.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, MAX(DECODE(D.GR_QTY,'0',DECODE(SIGN(ABS(D.IV_QTY)),1,'송장생성','송장미생성'), DECODE((NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) - NVL((D.GR_QTY),0)),0,'입고완료','부분입고'))) STATUS_TEXT, MAX(D.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(D.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(D.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(D.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(D.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MAX(D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE) AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, MAX(H.AGENT) AS AGENT_CODE, MAX(R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_CODE, MAX(H.PURCHASER_ID) AS PO_USER_ID, MAX(R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_CODE, MAX(R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_ID, MAX(D.CONTRACT_NO) AS CONTRACT_NO, MAX(D.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ, D.BUYER AS BUYER, MAX(B.CATEGORY_NO) AS BUYER_CATEGORY_NO, MAX(C.CATEG_NAME) AS BUYER_CATEG_NAME, MAX(C.CATEG_PATH) AS BUYER_CATEG_PATH, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D' AND AGENT = 'KR00000002')) STOCK_CNT, MAX(A.QUOTATION_NO) AS QUOTATION_NO, MAX(A.QUOTATION_SEQ) AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT D, ICOMGRDT G, ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPRDT R, ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMBYCA C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','T','Y','A','C') AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.BUYER=C.COM_CODE AND B.CATEGORY_NO=C.STD_CATEG_ID AND D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER AND D.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND D.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND D.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ AND D.BUYER =#{st_buyer_code} AND D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = G.BUYER(+) AND D.PO_NO = G.PO_NO(+) AND D.PO_SEQ = G.PO_SEQ(+) AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND R.STATUS <> 'D' AND 'D' <> G.STATUS(+) AND R.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY D.BUYER, D.PO_NO, D.PO_SEQ, NVL(G.AGENT_PRICE, D.AGENT_PRICE) ORDER BY D.BUYER, D.PO_NO, D.PO_SEQ )A
